info.name: Glofox Memberships
info.description: Local-profile reviewer scenarios. Start a fresh application, run folders in order; inventory folder requires five fresh promo slots. All IDs are discovered/extracted. No public recovery/reset endpoint is invented. See docs/07-local-setup-and-manual-testing.md. A quick run may leave recovery pending; rerun folder 07 after the 90-second age gate. Sequential runs do not prove concurrency.

item.name: 01 - Plans
item.description: Discover actual IDs from the list response; there are no plan create/get-one/reset routes.

request.description: Requires running app; baseUrl only. Expected four plans including inactive Legacy Plan. Saves plan IDs for later scenarios. Read only.

item.name: 02 - Successful Purchase
item.description: Run after plan discovery. Demonstrates successful class-pack and unlimited purchases with independent fresh keys/members, then reads both snapshots. Folder 04 separately demonstrates unlimited uniqueness.

request.description: Requires local setup and discovered plan variables. Uses currentKey/currentPayload generated by its pre-request script. Expected 201 with an active purchase snapshot. Creates persistent demo workflow/purchase data.

exec: if (!plan) throw new Error("Run 01 - Plans / List Plans first");
const payload = {memberName: "Review Member " + pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$guid}}"), planId: plan, startDate: "2026-11-02"};

request.description: Requires purchaseId extracted from the preceding purchase response. Expected 200 active snapshot with the same ID. Read only; no new purchase.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("purchaseId")) { throw new Error("Run the preceding successful purchase first"); }
pm.test("Same purchase", function () { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("purchaseId")); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("active"); });

request.description: Requires local setup and discovered unlimitedPlanId. Generates a fresh member name and idempotency key on every execution. Expected 201 with planType unlimited, null credits and active status. Creates one purchase and an active unlimited claim; independent of folder 04 uniqueness scenarios.

exec: if (!plan) throw new Error("Run 01 - Plans / List Plans first");
const payload = {memberName: "Review Unlimited " + pm.variables.replaceIn("{{$guid}}"), planId: plan, startDate: "2026-11-02"};

pm.test("Unlimited plan snapshot", function () { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.planId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("unlimitedPlanId")); pm.expect(body.planType).to.eql("unlimited"); pm.expect(body.credits).to.eql(null); });

request.description: Requires unlimitedPurchaseId extracted by Purchase Unlimited Membership. Expected 200 with the same active unlimited purchase; read only.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get("unlimitedPurchaseId")) { throw new Error("Run the preceding successful purchase first"); }
pm.test("Same purchase", function () { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("unlimitedPurchaseId")); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("active"); });

request.description: Requires running app. Expected page 0, limit 20 and content array; no data changes.

exec: pm.test("Page contract", function () { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.limit).to.eql(20); pm.expect(body.content).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(body.totalElements).to.be.at.least(2); });

item.name: 07 - Saga Recovery
item.description: No recovery-trigger endpoint exists. The scheduler works in the background. Allow at least 90 seconds of inactivity plus a cron tick; retry this folder with the same saved key. A fast whole-collection run can report pending without demonstrating completion.

request.description: Requires Prepare Ambiguous Payment and restored SUCCESS. Reuses recoveryKey/recoveryPayload. After recovery, expected 201 same logical purchase; before due recovery, 409 IN_PROGRESS is a valid pending observation. No manual recovery endpoint is invoked. Repeat this request later with the same saved key.

exec: if (!key || !payload) throw new Error("Run the scenario's initial purchase first");
pm.test("Recovery complete or explicitly pending", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201,409]); });
pm.test("Recovered active purchase", function () { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("active"); pm.expect(body.id).to.be.a("string"); });
if (previous) pm.test("Same recovered purchase", function () { pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(previous); });
console.info("Recovery is pending. Keep the application running and rerun folder 07 after the inactivity gate and cron tick.");

request.description: Requires recoveredPurchaseId extracted from the preceding purchase response. Expected 200 active snapshot with the same ID. Read only; no new purchase. Skipped while recovery is still pending.

exec: pm.test("Same purchase", function () { const body=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("recoveredPurchaseId")); pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("active"); });
